api._comment_source: "wco" = download each episode from wco.tv (see the wco block below). Set this to anything else to use the JSON API mode and supply api.url + queryTemplate.

wco._comment: Primary source. The trusted Firefox profile (wco-profile-ff) opens the episode page only to mint the signed embed token; everything after that runs as plain HTTP via curl_cffi (player page -> getvidlink.php -> getvid?evid= -> direct mp4). Mirrors are tried in turn; paced retries help against embed-host throttling. 'proxy' optionally routes ONLY the tiny browser/token step through a rotating residential proxy (hybrid mode, cost ~zero) - use a sticky-session endpoint so one episode keeps a single exit IP. headed=true to watch the browser work.
